description: Ordinary walking at actual size: left v1.9 archived evaluator; middle v2.0.5 released procedural rig; right v2.0.6 working original painted walk restoration. Cream top, Silver bottom.
renderer: Production C++ evaluators and v2.0.5 Rig raster, Pillow final affine placement and premultiplied blend. Not Win32/GDI+ or live Box2D/window execution.
body_scale: Adult, normal nutrition, 96 DPI; common source scale 110 / max(first six cropped frame heights).
original_frame_scale: Fixed shared scale, alpha >16 crop plus 2px padding, lower-center placement.
candidate_walk: Four original whole painted poses, 14 logical body px/cycle, hold 60% then SmoothStep blend final 40%. No procedural paw warp, scale pulse, body angle, or decorative lift.
review: 160 character samples match archived v1.9 frame, blend frame, blend weight and original 14px phase. Candidate fixed transform and floor alignment checked. Full face/paw stills inspected for both characters.
visual_findings: Candidate preserves original painted limb contours. v2.0.5 shows a triangular alpha gap beside the near foreleg in part of its cycle. Four original drawings still differ slightly in face/tail shape; brief crossfades are visible on close inspection.
limits: Preview verifies rendering/cadence comparison, not biological gait realism or absence of every visible imperfection. Actual Windows build, integration tests and package/feed validation are separate release checks.
